newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian tenor Misciano, 87, killed in fall.
newsitem.headline: Italian tenor Misciano, 87, killed in fall.

text.p: Italian tenor Alvinio Misciano, 87, who was a singing teacher of superstar Luciano Pavarotti, was killed in a fell from a window of his home in Milan on Friday, Italian television said.
It said Misciano, an accomplished tenor of the 1950s and 1960s, had apparently suffered a dizzy spell before he lost his balance and plunged to his death from the upper window.
Pavarotti, who is in New York, said he was upset at the news.
"He was a great tenor and...a great friend," Pavarotti told the Italian news agency ANSA.
